Title: Move Fastened Button/Buttonhole
Content: List of Contents Move Fastened Button Only Move Fastened Button and Buttonhole Objective Move a fastened button only, or a button and buttonhole together. Location Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Operation Move Fastened Button Only Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Click and drag the desired button in the 2D or 3D window. The selected button is moved to where the mouse is released. The moved button stays fastened. Move Fastened Button and Buttonhole Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Hold down Shift on the keyboard, then click all buttons and buttonholes to be moved in the 2D or 3D window. Click and drag the selected buttons and buttonholes. The selected buttons and buttonholes are moved to where the mouse is released. The moved buttons and buttonholes stay fastened.

Title: Offset as Internal Line
Content: Offset as Internal Line Offset as Internal Line - Create Internal Lines based on the selected Internal Line or Internal Shape with the designated interval. Offset an Internal Line - Select the Edit Pattern tool from the 2D toolbar. - Navigate to the 2D window and right click on the Internal Line to be duplicated and select Offset as Internal Line from the pop-up menu. - The Offset as Internal Line Window will appear. - Designate the Number of Offsets and Distance. - The preview of duplicated Internal Lines will appear in the 2D window. To change the direction of the duplicated Internal Lines, toggle on Reverse Direction. - To extend the duplicated Internal Lines to meet the Pattern outline, toggle on Extend. - Select OK. - The Internal Line will be duplicated based on the setting. Offset an Internal Shape - Select the Transform Pattern tool or the Edit Pattern tool from the 2D toolbar. - Navigate to the 2D window and right click on the Internal Shape to be duplicated and select Offset as Internal Line from the pop-up menu. - The Offset as Internal Line Window will appear. - Designate the Number of Offsets and Distance. - The preview of duplicated Internal Shapes will appear in the 2D window. To change the direction of the duplicated Internal Shapes, toggle on Reverse Direction. - Select OK. - The Internal Shape will be duplicated based on the setting.

Title: Edit Curvature
Content: Edit Curvature Edit Curvature - Convert a straight line to a curve or edit the curvature of a curve. - Select the Edit Curvature tool from the 2D toolbar. - Or, navigate to Main Menu and select 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curvature Convert a Straight Line to a Curve - Click and drag a part of a straight line. - The straight line will be converted to a curved line. Edit the Curvature of a Curve - Click and drag the curve created with the Edit Curve Point tool or the AI Bezier Curve method. - The curve will be exaggerated or moderated.

Title: Particle Distance
Content: List of Contents Particle Distance Adjust Particle Distance Particle Distance - Adjust Particle Distance to manage the Garment quality and Simulation speed. - Navigate to Property Editor Simulation Properties Particle Distance Adjust Particle Distance - Using the Transform pattern tool, select the Pattern to be edited. - Navigate to the Property Editor Simulation Properties Particle Distance. - The default value of the Particle Distance is 20. Lower this value to 5 and simulate. - The quality of the 3D Garment increases as the size of the Particle Distance decreases.

Title: Free Sewing
Content: List of Contents Free Sewing Create Free Sewing Directional Notch Free Sewing - Freely create Sewing Lines on Pattern outlines and Internal Lines. - Select the Free Sewing tool from the 2D toolbar. - Or, navigate to the Main Menu and select Sewing Free Sewing Create Free Sewing - Four clicks are needed to create a pair of Free Sewing Lines. Freehand Sewing - Navigate to the 2D window and hover over the Pattern outline or the Internal Line where the Sewing Line should be created. A blue point will follow along the mouse cursor. - Click on the Pattern outline or the Internal Line to start the Sewing Line. Drag the mouse cursor to designate the direction. Then, click again to complete the first half of the Sewing Line. - Create the second half of the Sewing Line as above. When click and dragging the mouse cursor after establishing the start point, a blue point will appear to guide the length of the first half of the Sewing Line. Click again to complete the second half of the Sewing Line. Create Sewing with Designated Value - While click and dragging the mouse cursor after establishing the start point, right-click to access the create Sewing Line window. - Type in the desired value and select OK. - When the length of the Sewing Line is designated, the end point of the Sewing Line will be created automatically. Directional Notch - The Directional Notchs position alters depending on the movement of the mouse cursor. - To reset the Directional Notch of the first half of the Sewing, you must cancel the action and restart. - To cancel the first half of the Sewing Line, hit the Esc key or the Ctrl+Z keys on the keyboard. - To reset the Directional Notch of the second half, cancel the action before creating the end point and recreate the Sewing Line. - To cancel the second half of the Sewing Line, hit the Delete key or the Backspace key on the keyboard.

Title: Edit Curve Point
Content: List of Contents Edit Curve Point Edit Free Curve Points Add Free Curve Points to Free Curves Delete Free Curve Points Edit Curve Point - Add and edit free curve points on segments. - Select the Edit Curve point tool from the 2D toolbar. - Or, navigate to Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curve Point. Edit Free Curve Points - Select the Edit Curve Point tool from the 2D toolbar. - Navigate to the 2D window and click on a segment to add a curve point. - Click and drag the added curve point to edit the curvature. - Or, click and drag the segment to add and edit the curvature simultaneously. - Select and move multiple Curve Points at once. While moving the Curve Points, right click to type in desired Distance Moved (ver.4.2.0). Add Free Curve Points to Free Curves - Select the Edit Curve Point tool from the 2D toolbar. - When a curve point is added to a free curve, the curve will be modified based on the added curve point. Delete Free Curve Points - Select the Edit Curve Point tool from the 2D toolbar. - Select the curve point and hit the Delete key on the keyboard. - The selected curve point will be deleted. - Select and delete multiple Curve Points at once(ver.4.2.0).

Title: Attach to Avatar Tape
Content: List of Contents Attach to Avatar Tape Attach Pattern to Avatar Tape Detach Pattern from Avatar Tape Attach to Avatar Tape - Attach Pattern outlines or Internal Lines to Avatar Tapes. - Select the Attach to Avatar Tape tool from the 3D toolbar. - Or, navigate to Main Menu and select Avatar Avatar Tape Attach to Avatar Tape. Attach Pattern to Avatar Tape - To attach a Pattern to an Avatar Tape, you will need to click the part of Pattern to be attached to the Avatar and the Avatar Tape. - In the 3D window, click on the Pattern outline or the Internal Line to be attached to the Avatar. The Pattern with the selected line will turn translucent as the line is highlighted in red. - Click the Avatar Tape on the Avatar. The Pattern will no longer be translucent as the Avatar Tape is highlighted in red. - When the Simulation tool is activated, the selected Pattern outline or Internal Line will attach to the Avatar Tape. Detach Pattern from Avatar Tape - In the 3D window, click the Pattern outline or Internal Line attached to the Avatar Tape. - Hit the Delete key on the keyboard. The line highlighted in red will return to black. - When the Simulation tool is activated, the Pattern will detach from the Avatar.

Title: Offset as Internal Line along Curve
Content: List of Contents Offset as Internal Line along Curve Number of Offsets Offset Distance to Segment Edge Straight Line Perpendicular Direction Offset as Internal Line along Curve - Create Internal Lines between two Pattern outlines along their curve. - Select two lines and right click to access the pop-up menu. Then, select Offset as Internal Line along Curve. - With the Edit Pattern tool, select two lines which Internal Lines will offset In between. Then, right-click and select Offset as Internal Line along Curve. - The Offset as Internal Line along Curve window will appear. Number of Offsets - Set how many Internal Lines will be created in between the selected lines. Offset - Set the distance between the offset Internal Lines. Distance to Segment Edge - Set how far the offset Internal Lines will apart from the Pattern outline. Reverse Direction - Horizontally reverse the Internal Lines position based on the Di"stance to Segment Edge. Opposite Segment - Vertically reverse the Internal Lines position based on the Distance to Segment Edge. Straight Line - Create offset Internal Lines as straight lines. Perpendicular Direction - The offset Internal Lines will be created perpendicular to the Pattern outlines.

Title: Invert Selection
Content: Invert Selection - Invert the Pattern selection, selecting the Patterns currently not selected. - Select the Transform Pattern tool or the Edit Pattern tool from the 2D toolbar. - Navigate to the 2D window and right click on the desired Pattern to select Invert Selection from the pop-up menu. - The selection will be inverted, selecting the ones that are not currently selected.

Title: [Property] Create Button Texture
Content: Objective Create and apply custom textures to buttons in CLO in order to express various button styles. UV maps for each default button are included in the CLO Asset Library as photoshop files. The files can be opened and edited in Adobe Photoshop to apply custom textures and logos to the existing button shapes. When UV maps are used, all images or type will increase or decrease in size when the button width, ligne, or thickness are changed in CLO. Operation Download UV maps of buttons from the Library window. Locate the asset folder on your computer. (PC: C:UsersPublicDocumentsCLOAssets / MAC: User/Library/Application Support/CLO) Note: on PC you can right click on the folder name in CLO Library and choose Copy the path. Then you can paste this path location into a file browser to locate it. Open .psd file in Adobe Photoshop. There are 4 types of layouts that UV maps will have. Each part has a separate layer with a shape defining the section that needs to be filled or covered. An image can be placed/embedded or a pattern Define and filled to cover the desired location. Type can allose be added. Hide UV outlines and Text layers, then save the image. Note: Saving the image in .jpeg format is recommended. Open the custom saved UV map through the Texture section of the button property.

Title: Zipper/Slider Right-Click Pop-Up Menu
Content: Objective Modify the Zipper or Slider via the right-click pop-up menu. Location 3D Toolbar Select/Move Right-Click on a Zipper or Slider Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar Select/Move Right-Click on a Zipper or Slider The respective pop-up menu appears for the Zipper or Slider. Adjust the settings below as needed: Zipper Tape Slider Delete Delete the selected Zipper and Zipper Slider. Deactivate Deactivate or activate the selected Zipper and Slider. Freeze Freeze or unfreeze the selected Zipper and Slider. Reverse (Right-Clicked Teeth) Reverse the sewing direction of the Zipper Tape based on the side of the Zipper Tape that was right clicked. n/a Flip Normal (Right-Clicked Teeth) Flip the surface of the side of the Zipper Tape that was right clicked. n/a Reset Slider Arrangement n/a Reset the slider's position and angle to default (ver4.1.0). Show/Hide Slider n/a Show or hide the Slider (ver4.0.0).

Title: Zipper Teeth & Tape Properties
Content: Objective Modify the Zipper teeth &amp tape properties. Location 3D Toolbar Select/Move Operation Select the tool/menu indicated. Modify the Zipper Teeth properties based on the available options below. Properties Description Line Length Edit the length of the Zipper teeth. Preset Set the type of the Zipper. Teeth Type (ver 7.1) Set the Teeth Type as Texture or OBJ. Space (Only OBJ) Adjust the space between the Zipper Teeth. Size (ver 7.0) Set the size of the Zipper. Teeth Width Enter directly the width of the Zipper to adjust. Total Width Adjust the total width of the Zipper. Thickness Set the Zipper teeth Thickness. Particle Distance Adjust Zipper teeth's Particle Distance. Fasten Zipper Zip or unzip the Zipper. Fold Adjust the Strength and Angle of the fold for Sewing between the Zipper and Pattern. Material Set the Material Type, Texture, Color and Opacity of the Zipper Teeth and Tape. Physical Property Adjust physical properties to the selected zipper teeth.

Title: Play Animation
Content: Objective Play the recorded garment animation. Location Animation Mode Animation Editor Upper Toolbar Note Edit Animation Tools (Start) Moves to the beginning of the play area. (Play) Plays the play area. (Pause) Pauses temporarily on the play area. (End) Moves to the end of the play area. (Repeat) Repeats the play area. (1x) Changes the play speed. (1/4x, 1/2x, 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x) (Frame Stepping /Real Time) Changes the play unit in frames or seconds. Set the first frame to be played. (Click-and-drag on the timeline also allows to set the first frame.) Set the last frame to be played. (Click-and-drag on the timeline also allows to set the first frame.)

Title: Guide for Installing Network Version in the Same Network Envrionment
Content: List of Contents Guideline for Installing Network Version in the Same Network Environment 1. Check-up on HASP Driver Installation on Server PC 2. Additional Set-up ACC Page on Client PC Guide for Installing Network Version in the same Network Environment Objective Install Network version in the same Network Environment when Server (PC connected to the red HASP Key) is unable to recognize Client (PC to run the software). 1. Check-up on HASP Driver Installation on Server PC Operation Access to the Web Browser: http://localhost:1947 Check Sentinel HASP Driver is installed and operating on Server as shown in the image below. If the web page does not appear, reinstall Sentinel HASP Driver. HASP Driver Install Guide 2. Additional Set-up ACC Page on Client Operation Set up ACC page on PC you want to run the software. ACC Page : http://localhost:1947 Click on Configuration (the red box in the image below). Click Access to Remote License Managers. Check on 'Aggressive Search for Remote Licenses' (image below) and type the Server PC IP in "Specify Search Parameters" then click Submit. Note: How to check your IP: Windows Search Search 'Cmd.exe' Type 'ipconfig' http://www.ghacks.net/2011/05/17/network-troubleshooting-basics-the-ipconfig-command/ Wait for 10 seconds and its completed when HASP key page shows up (image below). If the page does not show up, the Server and Client may possibly be connected to different network environment. In that case, follow the link below, follow the guideline and try again. Guideline for Installing Network Version on the Internet Environment

Title: Show/Hide Bond/Skive
Content: Objective Show or hide bonded or skived area in the 3D window (ver2.3.0). Location Main Menu Display 3D Trims Show Bond/Skive (ver4.2 or earlier) 3D Trims Display Icon Show Bond/Skive (ver4.2 or earlier) Main Menu Display 3D Trims Show Bond/Skive (ver5.0 or later) 3D Window 3D Trims Display Icon Show Bond/Skive (ver5.0 or later) Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Trims Display Icon Show Bond/Skive The selected area's bond/skive in the 3D window is now being shown or hidden.

Title: [Object Browser] Delete Button Style
Content: Objective Delete unnecessary button styles. Location Object Browser Button Tab Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Button Tab Select a button style to be deleted. Press Delete on keyboard or right click on the button style and select Delete option. The selected button style is not deleted.

Title: [2D Tool] M:N Segment Sewing
Content: Objective Easily sew multiple segments (M) to multiple segments (N) at once and edit them as a group. When the total length of multiple segments corresponding to M is different from the total length of multiple segments corresponding to N, N segments are divided in proportion to M segments. Location Main Menu Sewing M:N Segment Sewing 2D Toolbar M:N Segment Sewing Note: Hold down the Segment Sewing tool for a while to access the M:N Segment Sewing tool. Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Sewing M:N Segment Sewing 2D Toolbar M:N Segment Sewing Click on the segments belong to M segments. Then, hit the Enter key on the keyboard to complete M sewing lines. M sewing lines are highlighted in neon color. As checking the Directional Notches, establish Sewing Lines on N segments. Then, hit the Enter key on the keyboard to complete. The Sewing Lines no longer appear in neon color. Note: While establishing M:N sewing lines, hit the Delete key on the keyboard to cancel the last action or hit the Esc key on the keyboard to cancel all actions. When you click on an inappropriate segment while sewing, the segment appears in red and you cannot establish Sewing Line on the selected segment.

Title: Reset 3D Arrangement
Content: Objective Return arrangement of the entire or selected Patterns back to pre-simulation state in the 3D window. Use this function when draping does not operate properly after arranging around the Avatar. Location Selected Pattern 3D Pattern Right-Click Pop-Up Menu Reset 3D Arrangement (Selected) All Pattern Main Menu 3D Garment Reset 3D Arrangement (All) 3D Toolbar Reset 3D Arrangement (All) Operation Selected Pattern Select a 3D Pattern to reset its arrangement. Note: Press Shift key on keyboard to select multiple Patterns. Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Pattern Right-Click Pop-Up Menu Reset 3D Arrangement (Selected) The selected Pattern is now being rearranged back to pre-simulation state. All Pattern Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 3D Garment Reset 3D Arrangement (All) 3D Toolbar Reset 3D Arrangement (All) The entire Pattern is now being rearranged back to pre-simulation state.

Title: Rotate
Content: List of Contents Rotate Clockwise/Counterclockwise X/Y Axis Parallel To Objective Rotate Patterns and Internal Shapes/Lines based on various references. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern Operation Rotate Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern Select the Pattern or Internal Shapes/ Lines or Baselines to be rotated. The marquee box appears around the selected item. Click and drag the rotate point on top of the marquee box. The selected item rotates towards the mouse. Note: While clicking and dragging the Pattern, Internal Shapes/Lines, or Baselines, right click to access the Rotate window. Type in the desired angle, then click OK. The selected item rotates based on the entered value (ver3.2.0). Clockwise/Counterclockwise Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern Click on the Pattern or Internal Shapes/Lines to be rotated. Then, right click to access the pop-up menu. When the pop-up menu appears, select Clockwise (45º) or Clockwise (90º) or Counterclockwise (45º) or Counterclockwise (90º) The selected pattern rotates according to the chosen options. X/Y Axis Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern Click on the Pattern or Internal Shapes/Lines to be rotated. Then, right click to access the pop-up menu. When the pop-up menu appears, select X-Axis or Y-Axis. Select the line of a Pattern which should be rotated to the chosen axis. The selected Pattern or Internal Shapes/Lines are rotated to X-Axis or Y-Axis on the basis of the selected line. Parallel To Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern Click on the Pattern or Internal Shapes/Lines to be rotated. Then, right click to access the pop-up menu. When the pop-up menu appears, select Parallel to... Select the line of any Patterns or Internal Lines/Shapes in the 2D window which the previously selected Pattern or Internal Shapes/Lines are rotated to. This line acts as a fiducial line. The selected line turns red. Then, select the line of the rotating Pattern or Internal Shapes/Lines that will rotate parallel to the fiducial line selected above. The Pattern or Internal Shapes/Lines rotates parallel to the fiducial line.

Title: Edit Curve Point
Content: List of Contents Add Edit Objective Add and edit curve points on Pattern outlines and Internal Lines. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curve Point 2D Toolbar Edit Curve Point Operation Add Select the tool/menu indicated in Location Click the desired position of a segment to add a curve point. Or, Right click on a segment to split the segment by a curve point (ver 7.1) Split into Two Lines Adjust by entering the length of both lines which are divided by the right clicked point, or by entering the ratio. Split by Length Enter the number of segments the selected line should be divided into. You can change the direction in which a point is added to a start/opposite/center basis. Uniform Split Enter the number of segments the line should be divided into. The line is equally divided accordingly. A free curve point is created at the selected point. When a free curve point is added to an AI Bezier curve, the curvarture is changed based on the free curve point. Move Click and drag a curve point or press the arrow key on the keyboard to move. To enter Moved Distance, right click while click-and-dragging the Curve Point Distance Moved Type in the how much a segment or a point is moved. X/ Y Axis Type in how much a point is moved on X/ Y-axis. This option does not appear for segments.

Title: Align Points
Content: Objective Align multiple points along specific direction or axes (ver2.3.0). Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Points) Left / Center / Right / Top / Middle / Bottom / To Point (X-Axis) / To Point (Y-Axis) Operation Navigate to 2D toolbar and select the Edit Pattern tool. Select more than two points to be aligned. Right click on the fiducial point and follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Points) Left / Center / Right / Top / Middle / Bottom / To Point (X-Axis) / To Point (Y-Axis) The selected points are aligned according to the selected option.

Title: Use Layer (Drape Additional Garment)
Content: Objective This function allows easier Simulation when setting which layer to get in/outward among overlapped multiple layers. By using this function, taking out inaccurately inwardly simulated patterns such as pockets and buttons, gets easier. In addition, adding additional outerwear on top of garments such as dress and shirts. The default layer value of zero ('0') means the layer function is being off. In that state, the arrangement order of the Patterns gets decided. Operation Select a Pattern in the 3D window to set a layer with Select/Move tool. Pattern property appears in the Property Editor. In the Simulation Layer properties, enter the larer value than the inside pattern for the pattern to be placed on the outside, and enter the smaller value than the outside pattern for the pattern to be placed inside. The pattern with layer is displayed in color. Note: Right-click on the background of the 3D window and click Show/Hide Colors Layer to hide color. (ver 7.3) Click the Simulation tool. The order is applied and simulated according to the set layer values. Once simulating is complete in the desired order, change the layer values for all patterns to 0 for a stable simulation. The simulated result will remain in order.

Title: AI Graphic Generator (ver 7.3)
Content: List of Contents Open Generate Apply Objective Easily type in keywords to generate different graphic images to choose from to create new graphics. Note: AI Graphic Generator is being piloted as a Beta service, and may be suspended to provide better service. Location Object Browser Graphic tab Operation Open Click the tool/menu in Location. Click AI Graphic Generator button at the top of the Graphic tab or Graphic Properties Materials on the right side of Basic Parameters AI Graphic Generator window appears Generate Set options, enter prompts, and click the Generate button. Content Type Select the type of content. None Create an image without specifying characteristics of the graphic image. Art Set the characteristics (Embroidery, Patch, Pop Art) of the graphic image. Transparent Background Apply a transparent background to the image. Note: This option is not available for the Pop Art type. Text Prompt Enter the prompts. Writing Tips: List the words. Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. Emphasize certain words more. If parentheses are used in the word you want to emphasize, it takes up more weight.Parentheses on certain words take more weight. Weight increase rate : (word) 1.1 times, ((word)) 1.21 times. Maintain Prompt Even if the same prompts are used, the AI Graphic image is created newly each time. Thus, clicking the Maintain Prompt button may update the prompts while preserving the existing results as possible. It may differ from the existing results depending on the addition or change of the prompts. Random The sample prompt is randomly applied. History Previously generated images with prompts are recorded as history. History will remain until CLO software is closed. Note: It may take a while to create when there are many users at the same time. Apply Click the Apply button below when the AI Texture is completely generated. The result is applied to the 3D garment, and can be checked in advance. BUT, the graphic must be applied to it.

Title: Select/Move Point/Segment
Content: List of Contents Select Move Objective Modify Patterns, Internal, and Base (ver5.2) Shapes by moving points and segments. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Operation Select Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Click a point or segment of a Pattern or Internal Shape. The point or segment is selected. When there are multiple points or segments, a pop-up menu appears allowing you to select the desired one (ver3.0.0.) To select multiple points and segments, hold down the Shift key on the keyboard when clicking them. All clicked points and segments are selected. Or, click and drag on the 2D window to encompass points and segments to be selected with the marquee box. All points and segments inside the marquee box are selected. Move Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern Click and drag the Pattern or use the arrow keys. Hold down the Shift key or Ctrl key (Mac: command) while moving the point or segment. The point or segment can be moved in precise vertical, horizontal, or diagonal lines, or in its slope. The center point of the dart is moved along the direction of the center line's tilt (ver 7.3) Or, right click or hit F1 key (Mac: Ctrl) while moving the point or segment to type in distance moved. Option Description Distance Moved Type in the how much a segment or a point is moved. X-Axis (ver4.2.0) Type in how much a point is moved on x-axis. This option does not appear for segments. Y-Axis (ver4.2.0) Type in how much a point is moved on Y-axis. This option does not appear for segments. Note: If it is cumbersome to select Patterns using the Edit Pattern tool, use the Transform Pattern tool.

Title: Move with Arrow Keys (3D)
Content: List of Contents Move Patterns with Arrow Keys Set Specific Movement Increment Objective Select Patterns in the 3D window, then use the arrow keys on the keyboard to move them in specific increments. Location Move Patterns with Arrow Keys Main Menu 3D Garment Select/Move 3D Toolbar Select/Move Set Specific Movement Increment Main Menu Preferences Grid Properties Property Editor 3D Grid 3D Arrow Key Movement Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D/2D Window) Grid Properties Property Editor 3D Grid 3D Arrow Key Movement Operation Move Patterns with Arrow Keys Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 3D Garment Select/Move 3D Toolbar Select/Move Select Patterns or trims in the 3D window. Selected Patterns or trims are highlighted in yellow. Use the arrow keys on the keyboard to move the selected Pattern or trim. Arrow Keys Description Move selected Patterns or trims along or towards the positive y-axis. The Garment moves upwards. Move selected Patterns or trims along or towards the negative y-axis. The Garment moves downwards. Move selected Patterns or trims along or towards the negative x-axis. The Garment moves to the left. Move selected Patterns or trims along or towards the positive x-axis. The Garment moves to the right. + Ctrl Move selected Patterns or trims along or towards the negative z-axis. The Garment moves away from you. + Ctrl Move selected Patterns or trims along or towards the positive z-axis. The Garment moves towards you. Set Specific Movement Increment Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Preferences Grid Properties Property Editor 3D Arrow Key Movement Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) Grid Properties Property Editor 3D Arrow Key Movement Enter the desired distance moved with each arrow key input.

Title: Sublayer
Content: List of Contents Set Sublayer Apply Sublayer Definition of Sublayer Delete Sublayer Set Sublayer - Assign the order of patterns in layers. - Select the Set Sublayer tool from the 2D toolbar. - Or, navigate to the Main Menu and select 2D Pattern Set Sublayer. Apply Sublayer - When the Set Sublayer tool is selected, all Pattern texture will disappear in the 2D window. - Click on the Pattern as it will be highlighted in red. - Move the cursor as the red arrow follows along the mouse cursor. - Click on the other Pattern. - Navigate to the 3D window and activate the Simulation. - The Pattern that was clicked at the first time will be arranged above the Pattern that was clicked at the second time. Definition of Sublayer - The plus sign on the line connecting two selected Patterns indicates that the Pattern selected second will be placed above the Pattern selected first. - Click the plus sign to change it to a minus sign. - The minus sign indicates that the Pattern selected second will be placed below the Pattern selected first. Delete Sublayer - With the Set Sublayer tool activated, click on the arrow connecting two selected Patterns. - When the arrow is highlighted in yellow, hit the Delete key on the keyboard.

Title: Surface Circumference Measurement
Content: List of Contents Surface Circumference Measurement Measure Circumference Surface Circumference Measurement - Measure circumference of the Avatar, such as chest circumference and waist circumference, by going over the curves of the Avatars surface. - Select the Surface Circumference Measurement tool from the 3D Toolbar or navigate to and select Main Menu Avatar Measurement Surface Circumference Measurement. Measure Circumference - Select the Surface circumference Measurement tool from the 3D Toolbar. - Click total of three times to create a Circumference Measurement. - Click on the Avatar to create a start point of the circumference. - Move and click on the Avatar again to decide the direction of the circumference. - Lastly, hover the mouse over the line connecting the start and second point to decide the angle of the circumference. - When the desired circumference is achieved, click to complete. - Hold down the Shift key on the keyboard when creating the second and the third point to move the mouse in a straight line.

Title: Delete Line
Content: Delete Line - Delete a line from the 2D Window. - Select the Edit Pattern tool from the 2D Toolbar. - Navigate to the 2D Window, right click on a line to be deleted and select DELETE LINE. - The selected line will be deleted.

Title: Linear Avatar Tape
Content: List of Contents Linear Avatar Tape Create Tape Create Tape in Guidelines Linear Avatar Tape - Apply Linear Avatar Tapes to Avatars in the 3D window. - Select the Linear Avatar Tape tool from the 3D toolbar. - Or, navigate the Main Menu and select Avatar Avatar Tape Linear Avatar Tape. Create Tape - Select the Linear Avatar Tape tool from the 3D toolbar. - Click to create the start point of the Avatar Tape on the Avatar. A blue dot will be created. - Drag the mouse towards the direction the tape will be applied to and click to create the second point. A blue dot will appear as well. - Double click where the tape should be completed. The Avatar Tape will be created and highlighted in yellow. Create Tape in Guidelines - To create an Avatar Tape in guidelines, hold down the Shift key on the keyboard and click to create the start point. - Keep holding down the Shift key and click to establish the second point. - Double click where the tape should be completed. The Avatar Tape will be created and highlighted in yellow.

Title: Add Point/Split Line
Content: List of Contents Add Point/Split Line Add Point Split into Two Lines Split by Length Uniform Split Add Point/ Split Line - Add point to Pattern outlines and Internal Lines to split them. - Select the Add Point/Split Line tool from the 2D toolbar. - Or, navigate to Main Menu and select 2D Pattern Edit Add Point/Split Line. Add Point - Add point to Pattern outlines. - Add point to Internal Lines. Split into Two Lines - Select the Add Point/ Split Line tool from the 2D toolbar. Then, right click on a segment and select Split. - The Split Line window will appear. Click Split into Two Lines. - The selected line will be divided into two different length segments on the basis of the purple guide point. The desired length can be entered in the Line 1, the shorter segment and the Line 2, the longer segment. - The selected line will be divided into two different length segments on the basis of the purple guide point. The proportion of each segment can be entered in the Line 1, the shorter segment and the Line 2, the longer segment. Split by Length - Select the Add Point/ Split Line tool from the 2D toolbar. Then, right click on a segment and select Split. - The Split Line window will appear. Click Split by Length. - Segment Length: points will be added to the line with the Segment Length Interval, starting from one side of the line. - Number of Segments: set how many segments the line will be divided into. - Direction: set toward which direction the points will be added. Uniform Split - Select the Add Point/Split Line tool from the 2D toolbar. Then, right click on a segment and select Split. - The Split Line window will appear. Click Uniform Split. - Number of Segments: set how many segments the line will be equally divided into.
